# Soothe

Soothe tinges Obsidian with soothing colours while preserving its native look and feel. Readability is stated across dark and light modes on desktop, mobile and tablet.

![Soothe screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awesomedog/obsidian-soothe/HEAD/preview.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Soothe"
    author: "awesomedog"
    repo:   "awesomedog/obsidian-soothe"
    slug:   "soothe"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/soothe"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/awesomedog/obsidian-soothe"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awesomedog/obsidian-soothe/HEAD/preview.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Tinge Obsidian with soothing colors while preserving its native look and feel. Maintain readability across dark and light modes on desktop, mobile, and tablet."
}
```
